feature: Team Management and Invitations - the real artifacts/portal '/team' page (src/pages/customer-team.tsx), part of #1656. Adapted from Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/screens/Team Management.dc.html using this codebase's own React/Vite/Tailwind/shadcn/lucide patterns, wired against all 12 real routes on artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-team.ts via useTeamLive.ts/teamWire.ts: GET /portal/team (roster), POST /portal/team/invite, PATCH /portal/team/:userId/status, DELETE /portal/team/:userId/sessions, PATCH /portal/team/:userId/mfa-enforcement, POST /portal/team/:userId/unlock, POST /portal/team/:userId/reset-password, POST /portal/team/:userId/temp-password, POST /portal/team/:userId/reset-mfa, POST /portal/team/:userId/emergency-bypass, and PATCH /portal/team/:userId/manager. The landed design's own state-switcher/logic class carries no Billing/Customer-Admin role-assignment UI (the #3647 PATCH /portal/team/:userId/role route and the roster's isCustomerAdmin/hasBillingRole fields exist but are not drawn) - not covered here, per the design-source rule; see the finding filed for it.
notes: GET /api/portal/team's managerUserId field is new this build (Git #3996) - previously selected only inside the manager-assignment route itself (#2527), never projected on the roster read (contract pack #2895 §5 finding). Added so the page's 'Reports to' panel has something real to read instead of a second, unbuilt lookup.

WHAT THIS COVERS: the roster read's real auth-gate (403 for a caller with no customerId claim is the route's own contract, not asserted here without a non-customer test account; 200 with a real array for an authenticated customer account, including the managerUserId/isCustomerAdmin/hasBillingRole fields this build reads/added) and the page's honest not-signed-in state.

WHAT THIS DELIBERATELY DOES NOT COVER, AND WHY (no portal login page yet, #1648): artifacts/portal's RequireAuth renders an honest 'Sign in required' panel for an unauthenticated visitor - the same structural gap test-manifests/portal/billing.json and account-security-data-rights.json already document. The mutating actions (invite, suspend, sessions revoke, MFA enforcement/reset, unlock, password reset/temp-password, emergency bypass, manager assignment) are exhaustively covered by portal-team.test.ts's own vitest suite (14 tests) against the auth/capability gate and business logic directly - this manifest does not re-drive them against a live account whose customer:team.manage grant state isn't established for any test-manifests/portal/*.json account today (the same reasoning team-role-assignment.json's own notes give for not asserting a live 200 grant).
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.

NOT YET RUN via shaneapp://runTest as of this build (2026-09-13): the local dev-server checkout does not yet have this branch merged/deployed, the same structural gap billing.json's own notes document for the same reason. Verified instead by: a real `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` pass (0 errors) in both artifacts/portal and artifacts/api-server, and a real `vitest run src/routes/portal-team.test.ts` pass (14/14) in artifacts/api-server confirming the extended GET /portal/team response shape. Re-run this manifest via shaneapp://runTest once the dev-server merge/restart cycle has picked up this branch.
